books.section: The Rise of the Service Sector

stem: Which of the following best describes the trend shown in the chart?

options.text: Union membership rose steadily from 1979 to 2010
options.misconception: The line falls at every step, from 24.1 percent to 11.9 percent.

options.text: Union membership fell steadily from 1979 to 2010
Union membership stayed about the same from 1979 to 2010
options.misconception: The share was cut in half, from about a quarter of workers to about an eighth.

options.text: Union membership fell, then rose back above its 1979 level
options.misconception: The line never turns back up; 2010 is the lowest point shown.

rationales.A: The line falls at every step, from 24.1 percent in 1979 to 11.9 percent in 2010.
rationales.B: The chart shows union membership falling at every step, from 24.1 percent in 1979 to 11.9 percent in 2010.
rationales.C: A fall from 24.1 percent to 11.9 percent is a halving, not staying the same.
rationales.D: The line never turns back up; the 2010 value is the lowest on the chart.
rationales.general:
1. Read the line from left to right: 24.1 percent, then 20.1, then 16.0, then 13.4, then 11.9.
2. Every step goes down, and none goes back up.
3. By 2010 about one worker in eight belonged to a union, down from about one in four in 1979.
Remember: a line that only falls tells one story — steady decline.

stimulus.source_note: Chart plotted from U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey. The 1979 figure comes from the pre-1983 historical series; 1983 onward is the comparable series.
stimulus.text:
| Year | Union members as a share of U.S. workers |
| 1979 | 24.1% |
| 1983 | 20.1% |
| 1990 | 16.0% |
| 2000 | 13.4% |
| 2010 | 11.9% |

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey. The 1979 figure comes from the pre-1983 historical series; 1983 onward is the comparable series.

figures.caption: Union members as a share of U.S. wage and salary workers, 1979–2010. Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
figures.alt: Line chart showing union membership falling from 24.1 percent of U.S. workers in 1979 to 11.9 percent in 2010
